summary: A proposed Remote Job Entry protocol for submitting batch jobs from one network host to another. A user connects by Telnet to a special logger for control, and the server then uses FTP to fetch the job input and deliver the output. It was drafted by Chuck Holland and invited comment. It was replaced by RFC 407.

eli5.summary: You hand a big job to a faraway computer. It picks up the instructions, does the work, and sends back the printed results, just like dropping off and collecting laundry.
